sections.title: Sound of T
paragraphs: The letter name is (T) /tiː/. Its main sound is heard in the number (ten) /tɛn/. This letter has two spoken sounds, and it can also be silent.

sections.title: How to say T
paragraphs: Touch the ridge behind your upper teeth with your tongue tip. Stop the air completely, then release it with a burst. Do not vibrate your vocal cords, so the sound is voiceless. You can feel a small puff of air on your hand. For the tap sound, let the tongue tip strike that same ridge once, very fast, with voice.

sections.title: Spelling rules for T
paragraphs: At the start of a word or in stressed syllables, say the sound in (top) /tɒp/. Between vowels before an unstressed syllable, say the quick tap in (water) /wɔː.tər/ or (city) /sɪ.ti/. This sign is a silent letter in words like (listen) /lɪs.ən/ and (castle) /kɑːs.əl/.

sections.title: Common mistakes with T
paragraphs: Do not touch your upper front teeth directly with the tongue tip. That touch makes the consonant dental. Keep the tongue tip further back on the gum ridge. Do not say this sign when it sits in words like (listen) /lɪs.ən/.
